overclaim_reject_rule: reject any claim that T010/T011 proves fill probability or maker execution viability

overclaim_reject_rule: reject exact queue position or queue-priority proof claims from public depth proxy
next_design_implication: later contract/design must distinguish exact queue proof from conservative supporting diagnostics

overclaim_reject_rule: reject claims that public book feasibility proxy proves exchange post-only behavior
next_design_implication: later contract/design must define response evidence before any endpoint or runner implementation

overclaim_reject_rule: reject claims that proxy rows prove cancel-fill race risk or safety
